categories.name: out_of_predicate_semantic_survivors
categories.owning_boundary: Post-Solve QM Semantic Boundary (Uncertified Full QM Obligations)
categories.mathematical_assumptions: The host-derived characteristic polynomial certifies only the scalar determinant identity det(lambda I - H) = P(lambda). It does not certify spectral projectors, time-dependent transition probabilities, reduced density matrices, concurrence, maximal CHSH Bell violations, or thermal state partial transpose eigenvalues. A downstream completion that couples an authentic intermediate certificate with false prose claims (e.g. asserting universal maximal CHSH violation or universal thermal entanglement for all beta > 0) is not falsified by scalar polynomial verification alone.
categories.metamorphic_relation: Adversarial mutations that preserve an authentic intermediate charpoly certificate while asserting false downstream quantum mechanical claims are accepted by the intermediate host verifier (valid=True) while final_answer_certified remains False. Because no host verifier checks downstream QM prose, the downstream error survives intermediate checking (status='SURVIVOR'). Degeneracy defects at J=Delta=0 cannot be resolved by scalar charpoly alone without projector analysis (status='UNRESOLVED').
